Inside Padelo

Tournament Highlights, Our Upcoming Festive Night & Updates from Fabien

     

Welcome

Looking out over the courts every evening, it is incredible to see how much energy and camaraderie fills our club, from high-stakes tiebreaks under the lights to animated match debriefs over cold drinks at the bar. This past month has been one of our most active yet, packed with brilliant rallies, friendly rivalries, and longtime members welcoming newcomers into the rotation. In this edition of our newsletter, we celebrate the standout moments from our recent Mixed Doubles Tournament and look ahead to our biggest gathering of the season: our Annual Festive Night. Grab a coffee, take a look at what is coming up, and get ready for a fantastic few weeks ahead.

Get Ready for Our Annual Club Festive Night!

Mark your calendars, our biggest celebration of the year is officially around the corner! Join us on Saturday, November 14th, for our Annual Club Festive Night, where we trade competitive pressure for an evening of casual mixed play, live music, and fantastic food. Whether you are stepping onto the courts for our social exhibition mini-matches or heading straight to the bar for tapas, craft beers, and our signature house punch, this is the perfect night to celebrate the players and friendships that make our community so vibrant. Spots are limited to ensure everyone gets plenty of court and terrace time, so head over to the club app or stop by the front counter to reserve your ticket before bookings close.

Recap: Last Month’s Thrilling Mixed Doubles Tournament

Last month’s Mixed Doubles Tournament delivered an unforgettable weekend of fierce rallies, strategic lobs, and remarkable club spirit. With 32 teams battling across three divisions, every court saw intense action right through to a breathtaking championship tiebreak that brought the entire terrace to its feet. Congratulations to our champions, Elena and Marc, who edged out a dramatic final set, and a huge round of applause to all the finalists and first-time tournament players who left everything on the turf. Beyond the trophies, the highlight was seeing everyone pack the clubhouse long after the final match for post-game drinks and celebration. Check out the event gallery on our website to find your action shots and podium photos!

A Final Word from the Owner

At the end of the day, a club is only as good as the community that brings it to life, and every single one of you makes this venue what it is. Whether you are fine-tuning your vibora during off-peak hours, jumping into social play on Friday evenings, or just stopping by the terrace to catch up with friends, thank you for bringing such positive spirit through our doors every week. I will see you around the clubhouse and on the courts, don’t hesitate to come say hello or challenge me to a set!

Warm regards,

Club Owner & Founder
